scope: Independent design tasks in two tabs of the same browser and origin; no access-control changes
download_verification: Real Worker exports and per-tab browser file bytes verified; test intercepted the download click to avoid saving fixture files to the user downloads folder
limitations: Separate automation tab handles are required; calls to one tab share its document and queue.
Project library remains shared; agents should use different saved files and distinct shared cache paths.
Without Web Locks, each load starts a separate recovery session; saved library files remain available.
Overlap demonstrates concurrent tasks, not a multi-tab throughput or memory benchmark.
browser_smoke: Absolute browser path opens a library file
Relative path rejected without replacing the document
